title: Lenin
plot_overview: In a village shaped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man challenges the traditions that keep violence alive. His struggle puts him against a deeply rooted cycle that has defined life in the community for years.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy a story about challenging entrenched traditions and cycles of violence; not for you if you prefer lighthearted plots or detailed character and story information upfront.
review_summary: Pros: compelling central conflict; village setting; themes of change | Cons: no review feedback; story details are limited
